items.title: 84 BCE: the earth is the campaign
items.summary: Twenty-seven attested peoples are playable. Where history has no state, the map uses cultural regions — not invented empires.
body: Choose Rome, Dacia, Han, Pandya, Saba, or another attested 84 BCE people.
Capitals can raise a storehouse, a training ground, or a civic hall. Study bow doctrine or ritual astronomy from the research panel.
Maya, Andean, Bantu, Siberian, and Australian lands are cultural regions. They do not count toward victory until developed.
Enter as Aurelian to load the finished Consular War as Rome — no password.
